meta.title: CentarStory
meta.description: CentarStory is a cultural guide to monuments, museums, food, and movement in the Municipality of Centar, Skopje.

common.walk: About {minutes} minutes on foot from Macedonia Square.
common.atSquare: You are on Macedonia Square, the point the other walks are measured from.
common.disclaimer: CentarStory is a cultural guide to the Municipality of Centar in Skopje. Walking times are approximate. Menus, tickets, and opening hours should be confirmed with the place itself. Bus fares are cited from the JSP Skopje price list.
common.errorBody: The page failed to load. You can try again.
common.notFoundTitle: This page is not in the atlas
common.notFoundBody: The link does not match a CentarStory page.
common.empty: Nothing in the atlas matches this filter.
common.scriptStrategy: Serbian in this atlas uses Latin script (Gajica) by design. Macedonian and Ukrainian use Cyrillic. Proper names keep their local forms.

explore.title: Atlas
explore.lede: An interactive atlas of Centar: monuments, museums, kitchens, and the verified walks that join them. Search, filter, or build a historical route from sourced relationships.
explore.located: Your position is on the atlas. It stays in this browser and is not sent with a route request.
explore.locateDenied: Location was not shared. The catalog still works.
explore.locateUnsupported: This browser has no location service.
explore.routeStreet: Street walking line, about {minutes} minutes. Geometry from the public OSRM service.
explore.routeDirect: Direct lines between stops. A street route did not load.
explore.eventsNote: Dated exhibitions use published start and end dates in Skopje time. Recurring festivals need this year’s poster. Nothing here is a ticket.
explore.selectPrompt: Choose a site from the map or the catalog.
explore.searchPlaceholder: Search a monument, person, museum, style, period, dish, or event
explore.destanUnmapped: Destan is listed in the Old Bazaar, but a unique verified coordinate was not confirmed. It is not shown as a precise pin.
explore.transportNote: JSP stops are not pinned here. Fares and the official planner live on Get Around. No invented coordinates.
explore.streetMeters: Street walking: {minutes} min, {meters} m, from the public OSRM foot router.
explore.approxMeters: Approximate path length {meters} m. Not a street-measured walking distance.
explore.approxNote: Approximate demo route. Straight lines are not precise walking distance.
explore.planningEstimate: Planning estimate about {minutes} min before a street route loads.
explore.theme_civic_axis: Civic axis of the square and bridge
explore.eventsEmpty: No dated event is verified as current.
explore.eventsEmptyBody: Use the official calendars rather than an invented listing.

scan.title: Look closely
scan.lede: Photograph a monument or upload an existing picture. CentarStory matches it to the verified catalogue of Centar — or says honestly when it cannot.
scan.cameraError: The camera could not be opened. You can upload a photograph instead.
scan.fileError: This file could not be read. Use a JPEG or PNG.
scan.privacy: In demo mode the photograph stays in this browser. Reference photographs are fetched only to compare colour and structure.
scan.uncertain: No profile is clearly closer than the others. Choose the place in front of you.
scan.confident: This is the closest on-device profile. Confirm it before you trust the story.
scan.modeDevice: Using on-device profiles. No remote recogniser is configured.
scan.modeRemote: A vision model will read the photograph on the server. The image is not stored after the request.
scan.modeDemo: Demo mode: comparison with credited reference photographs and on-device structure. This is not an AI identification.
scan.privacyRemote: The photograph is sent to the configured vision provider for this request only. Keys stay on the server. The file is not kept.
scan.lensIdle: Hold the lens to the monument.
scan.lensHint: Open the camera, or drop a JPEG, PNG, or WebP here. Permission is asked only when you tap.
scan.stepCamera: Open the camera or upload a photograph — never before you ask.
scan.stepMatch: The image is compared with the verified catalogue. Location is only a supporting hint.
scan.stepStory: Open the full story, the map, or a themed walk.
scan.catalogNote: Manual selection from the verified catalogue. This list is not an AI result.
scan.choose: Several places are plausible. Choose the one in front of you.
scan.outOfCatalogue: This does not belong to the supported catalogue.
scan.unknown: The object cannot be identified reliably.
scan.unknownBody: The photograph did not match a verified Centar landmark closely enough. You can retake it, or choose from the catalogue below.
scan.resultRemote: Scores are capped below certainty and combined with image evidence first. GPS never identifies a place on its own.
scan.resultDemo: This comparison uses credited reference photographs and structure. It is labelled demo, not an AI recognition result.
scan.fallbackLocal: The remote recogniser did not answer. The local comparison is shown instead, still labelled as demo.
scan.locationUsed: Your position was used only as supporting evidence.
scan.useLocation: Use my position as a hint
scan.referencesNote: These are the licensed photographs in the catalogue. In demo mode you can compare them yourself and open a story by hand. That choice is not an AI result.

museums.title: Houses of memory
museums.lede: Museums, memorial houses, and the national stage inside Centar. Hours and tickets are confirmed at the door.
museums.inventoryNote: This list is the verified cultural institutions inside Centar in the atlas. It is not every museum in Skopje.
museums.openToday: Open now, from the published weekday timetable.
museums.closedToday: Closed now, from the published weekday timetable.
museums.noOpenToday: No complete weekday timetable is published, so “open now” is not calculated.
museums.hoursUnverified: Confirm hours at the door. No complete published timetable is stored here.
museums.nearbyBody: No museum outside Centar is pinned as a Centar institution in this dataset. The Old Bazaar kitchen district sits in Čair and is labelled nearby on Traditional Food.
museums.exhibitionsLede: Only dated shows with official source pages appear as current. Past runs stay labelled past.
museums.noPhotograph: No verified photograph in this atlas

food.title: The table
food.lede: Dishes with a documented kitchen practice, and verified places to ask for them. Destan sits in the Old Bazaar, outside Centar, and is labelled nearby. Prices stay on the board in the room.
food.noneServed: No single house on this list owns the dish. Ask in the district that fits it.
food.priceBody: CentarStory does not print a menu price it has not verified. Read the board when you arrive.
food.inventoryNote: Two houses are verified in this pass: Pelister on Macedonia Square (Centar) and Destan in the Old Bazaar (nearby, unmapped). This is not a complete restaurant census of Centar.
food.priceCoverage: Menu prices are not printed here. Read the board in the room. Coverage of pricing is incomplete on purpose.
food.empty: Nothing in this verified set matches that search.
food.mapNote: Pelister shares the verified square coordinate. Destan has no unique map node in this pass and is not a pin.
food.recipeNote: Ingredients and methods here follow documented kitchen practice. No single recipe is treated as universal, and no origin myth is invented.

around.title: How to move
around.lede: The historic core of Centar is a walk. Buses, bicycles, scooters, and taxis cover the rest. Fares below are cited, not invented.
around.walkBody: Most of the atlas sits within a half hour of Macedonia Square. Times below are level estimates, not a promise on a hot uphill day.
around.busBody: City buses are run by JSP Skopje. The figures below are taken from the price list published on skopjebus.mk, as circulated with that list in February 2026. If the official page differs, the official page wins.
around.busHow: For a short stay, the Skopjebus app or a paper day ticket avoids buying a card. Validate the ride. Night service is a different fare. Use the planner for a line rather than guessing a number.
around.bicycleBody: The Vardar quay is the useful cycling edge through Centar. A public bike-share scheme has changed operator more than once, so this guide does not quote a membership price. Walk the Stone Bridge when it is crowded.
around.scooterBody: App-based electric scooters are sometimes deployed in the center. The unlock fee and the per-minute rate live in the operator's app on the street. CentarStory will not invent them. Do not ride through a crowded bridge.
around.taxiBody: Wizi publishes a Skopje tariff. Uber and Bolt are not presented here as local operators. Agree the meter or the app quote before the car moves.
around.airportBody: The airport operator's taxi price list dated 9 February 2024 prints {amount} for the Airport–Skopje ride ({distance}). Confirm the sheet posted at the terminal before you get in.
around.fareAppSingle: Single ride, electronic card or Skopjebus app, all lines
around.fareTenCity: Ten rides, city lines, valid 15 days
around.fareTenAll: Ten rides, all lines, valid 15 days
around.confirm: Confirm the current fare on the official page before you travel.
around.destUnmapped: This house has no unique verified coordinate, so walking geometry is not drawn.
around.busAccount: The SkopjeBus app (Modeshift) asks for an account: email, phone, or Google, Apple, or Facebook. Reduced fares are sold only at JSP customer-service centres. GPS is required for accurate in-app data.
around.busValidate: Validate a QR ticket at the onboard camera, or tap a Smart Card on the reader. A purchase is not a ride until it is validated.
around.busNoLive: This page does not promise that a numbered bus is running at a given minute. Use the official planner or live app for departures. Published line numbers at museum stops are not live times.
around.fareCaptured: Figures captured from the February 2026 list; official page rechecked {checked}.
around.ammStopsTitle: Published stops for the Archaeological Museum
around.ammStopsBody: The museum’s plan-your-visit page names these JSP stops and line numbers. They are useful nearby, not a live timetable.
around.bicycleShare: No currently functioning public bike-share in Centar was confirmed on 29 October 2026. Do not treat a historic municipal scheme as an active rental.
around.bicycleShop: A private rental shop website checked on that date did not load. No deposit, hourly rate, or collection address is quoted here.
around.scooterIntro: Two apps are documented. An official tariff is not the same as a scooter waiting on a Centar pavement. Check the live map in the app.
around.enjoyBody: Official pricing page, 29 October 2026. This does not prove a vehicle is parked in Centar at this moment.
around.binbinBody: The official help page describes account, QR unlock, card or wallet payment, and ending a ride with a photo. It uses examples outside North Macedonia and does not print a Skopje tariff. Confirm price and whether a scooter is nearby in the app.
around.wiziBody: Official Skopje city page. This is a published tariff, not a live quote for your ride.
around.noRideHail: Uber and Bolt are not listed as operating taxi apps in North Macedonia in this research pass.
around.compareIntro: Units differ. A bus fare is a ticket. A scooter quote is start plus minutes. A taxi quote is start plus assumed road kilometres. None of these is a live booking.
around.compareWalkTime: About {minutes} min on the atlas estimate from the square (level, not a timed walk).
around.compareBusPrice: 35 MKD app single if that February 2026 list still holds — confirm on skopjebus.mk.
around.compareBusTime: Unknown here. Use the official planner. This is not a live departure.
around.compareScooterPrice: Worked example, not a live quote: e-Enjoy 30 + 9.9 × {minutes} min (assumption: 40% of the walking estimate) = {amount} MKD.
around.compareScooterTime: Not timed. Depends on a vehicle being present and on traffic rules.
around.compareTaxiPrice: Worked example from Wizi’s tariff, not a live quote: 60 + 35 × {km} km (straight-line × 1.35 road factor) = {amount} MKD.
around.compareTaxiTime: Not timed. Waiting is a separate hourly charge.
around.compareUnknown: Not calculated — missing coordinates or unsupported claim.
around.compareAssumptions: Walking times are atlas estimates from Macedonia Square. Scooter minutes assume 40% of that figure. Taxi kilometres assume straight-line distance × 1.35. Confirm in the operator app or at the stop.
around.museumsOnFoot: {count} verified institutions are in the museum atlas.
